# Apache ECharts

- Version: 6.1.0
- Source: https://github.com/apache/echarts
- Distribution: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/echarts@6.1.0/dist/echarts.min.js
- License: Apache-2.0 (see `LICENSE` and `NOTICE`)
- Runtime: loaded locally and on demand when the POWER tab is opened.

The POWER gauges are configured from the official ECharts gauge primitives and
the `gauge-progress` / `gauge-grade` examples from the Apache ECharts examples
repository.
